summary: Verified header scroll bug fix in light theme. Header background is rgba(255,255,255,0.85) when scrolled on homepage and on subpages (/about). Dark theme regression: header is rgba(7,7,7,0.835) when scrolled (correct). Theme restored to 'light' at end (GET /api/settings/appearance returns {theme:'light'}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header light-theme scroll bug is fixed. bg-noir/85 correctly remaps to white translucent in light theme via .theme-light override in index.css. Dark theme unchanged. Final theme left as 'light'.
rca of the issue: Original: Nav.jsx header used tailwind 'bg-noir/85' when scrolled; the .theme-light override block in index.css only remapped 'bg-noir' but not the alpha-suffixed 'bg-noir/85' selector, so scrolled header stayed black. Fix: added '.theme-light .bg-noir\/85 { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85) }' plus a soft shadow to header.bg-noir/85 in light theme. Verified via computed styles on / and /about.
